title: Verify: PhaserHost zoom pass-in and refresh unit tests
summary: Mocked createGame tests for zoom at mount, resize and dpr change
description: Unit tests with createGame, ResizeObserver and matchMedia mocked prove zoom is passed in and refreshed.
acceptance_criteria: Resize and dpr change call setZoom then refresh
technical_constraints: Reuse FakeResizeObserver and createGameMock in the file; add setZoom: vi.fn() to the fake scale

steps.action: Add setZoom: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn> to scale in FakeGame and setZoom: vi.fn() in the factory.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserHost.test.tsx -t 'passes computeZoom'

steps.symbol: new: it('passes computeZoom(container size, dpr) to createGame')
steps.action: Stub window.devicePixelRatio=2 and define clientWidth 1280 and clientHeight 720 on HTMLElement.prototype via Object.defineProperty; render PhaserHost; assert createGameMock third argument equals computeZoom(1280,720,2).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserHost.test.tsx -t 'passes computeZoom'

steps.symbol: new: it('recomputes zoom and refreshes on resize and dpr change')
steps.action: Render, change clientWidth to 640 and devicePixelRatio to 1, invoke resizeCallbacks[0](); assert fakes[0].scale.setZoom called with computeZoom(640,720,1) and scale.refresh called. Then stub window.matchMedia to capture the change listener, re-render, fire it and assert setZoom is called again; unmount and assert removeEventListener was called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserHost.test.tsx -t 'recomputes zoom'
